column1: # FB5 WAT / WET parameter table  (tab-separated; lines starting with # are comments)
# This is the MOSIS "MOSIS PARAMETRIC TEST RESULTS" (WAT) layout: PROCESS PARAMETERS
# (Sheet Resistance / Contact Resistance) + CAPACITANCE PARAMETERS (Area / Fringe /
# Overlap), transcribed into a machine-readable form.
#   key        magic extract rule this row feeds (or INFO if informational)
#   ami_c5     AMI/onsemi C5 0.5um WAT measured value (public MOSIS report, run V11L,
#              plus the equivalent WPI/WAT handouts; same family as qflow osu050.par)
#   ibm_5hp    IBM SiGe 5HP value; '-' = NO public measurement found
#   status     MEASURED | DERIVED | PROXY | MISSING | INFO
#   source     [1] 20 MOSIS IBM SIGE05 WET lots (via design manual section 1)
#              [2] Dunn et al., IBM J. Res. & Dev. 47(2/3) 2003 Tables 4/6/7
#              [3] IBM 5HP BEOL: 1.2 um SiO2 ILD (published geometry)
#              [5] public MOSIS WAT report AMIS/ON-SEMI SCN05 run V11L
# !! IMPORTANT !!  The 20 IBM SIGE05 WET reports themselves are NOT bundled here and
# are NOT publicly indexed (see RC_SOURCES.md section 6).  Every 'MISSING' row means
# there is no 5HP measurement; fb5_5hp_rc.py currently fills those with a PROXY
# scaling that is explicitly NOT a measurement.  Drop the real WAT numbers into
# ibm_5hp + set status=MEASURED and re-run 'make check-parasitics' to replace them.
